findings.title: Config-flow device pre-fill page renders window errors with an unfilled {min_window_minutes} placeholder
findings.claim: When the setup wizard's device_prefill page refuses a DHW or silent-mode window shorter than 15 min, the form result carries no min_window_minutes placeholder, so the error string in all 4 language files is rendered with an unfilled {min_window_minutes} (8 field-language pairs), while the options flow's modbus_prefill page, the config dhw page and the options hot_water page supply it (0).
findings.mechanism: HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow._device_prefill_form passes description_placeholders={**device_prefill.disclaimer(), **notes}; the options twin _prefill_form adds **_WINDOW_PLACEHOLDERS. _prefill_errors (shared) can return dhw_window_too_short / silent_mode_window_too_short, whose strings read {min_window_minutes}.

findings.title: German run_optimization_no_prices message reads {entry_id}; the raise passes {entry_ids}
findings.claim: Of 4533 translated leaf strings compared with strings.json, exactly one names a different placeholder set: de exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message reads {entry_id} while services.py raises it with translation_placeholders={'entry_ids': ...}, so a German user who calls run_optimization with too few price steps gets a message whose entry placeholder is never filled.
findings.mechanism: Translation drift: the de string was written with the singular placeholder name; strings.json, en and sv use {entry_ids}, matching the raise at services.py (translation_key='run_optimization_no_prices').

evidence.unit: placeholder-parity mismatches (and 1 raise with an unsupplied placeholder)
